findings.finding: The node now has no open questions, records decided design decisions, and its design tasks are complete.
The remaining screen-side lifecycle tail is narrowed to Inbox, Exchange, Contacts, Comms, Exchange tab panes, and Provision rather than broadening back to mostly local wizard/settings screens.
The design chooses to migrate Exchange and its live tab panes together first, deferring any reusable screen-content helper until another real use case proves the abstraction.
Aggregate mail/comms workspaces remain the first migration tier, with lighter action-driven screens explicitly left lower priority.
The design does not rely on screen-owned shadow caches or bypass the shared control-lane bridge model.
